meta.title: "You agree just to avoid the awkwardness" — how to teach your child to separate their decisions from other people's emotions | Sila Slova
meta.description: Teach your child to spot manipulation through feelings and stop saying "yes" just because saying no feels awkward. Game-based course for children aged 10–16.

hero.headline: Your child says "yes" while inside it's a "no" — just to avoid the awkwardness?
hero.subheadline: "Come on, you're a normal person", "what, is it too much to ask?", "don't be like that". Nobody pushes directly — but saying no feels awkward. So the child agrees, just to make the discomfort go away.

media.alt: A child agreeing uncomfortably even though they don't really want to

pain.title: "Yes" not because they want to, but to avoid the awkwardness
pain.body:
Your child says "yes" while inside it's a "no". "Come on, you're a normal person", "what, is it too much to ask?", "don't be like that" — at school, among friends, in conversation. Nobody pushes directly, but saying no feels awkward. The child agrees just to avoid that discomfort.

But this isn't a request — it's manipulation through feelings. An emotion is created in the child — shame, awkwardness, the fear of looking "bad". And the decision is made not out of desire, but to make that feeling disappear.

Without the skill to spot it, the child agrees automatically. The result — they do not what they want, but what's "easier to get through". Not because they're spineless, but because they're reacting to social pressure.

faq.q: Is it a game or a learning course?
faq.a: Both at the same time. "Sila Slova" looks like a detective series, but every episode contains a hidden critical thinking lesson.

faq.q: What age is it suitable for?
faq.a: Ideal for 10–16 year olds. At this age, children are receptive to new thinking patterns and are still forming their views.

faq.q: How much time is needed each day?
faq.a: 15–20 minutes per episode. Flexible schedule — your child can come back at any convenient time.

faq.q: Is registration required for the demo?
faq.a: No. The demo episode is fully open — no registration, no subscription, no personal data required.
